overview: A premium Sri Lankan real-estate advertising platform where customers subscribe to a monthly plan and post property listings for buyers and renters to browse.
features: Browse and search property listings by category, location, price and bedrooms
Post your own property adverts with photos, contact details and WhatsApp
Four monthly advertising plans with automatic listing and image limits
Customer account with subscription details, payment history and My Listings
Admin console to approve listings, manage customers, plans, payments and banners
Rotating home page banner slider and a built-in help chatbot
